method: code review (medium depth) of the whole library and app

findings.summary: Cancelling one occurrence of a recurring meeting deletes the whole series
findings.scenario: The organizer cancels only next Friday's meeting; opening that mail deletes every future occurrence.

findings.summary: Cancellations and replies are applied without checking who sent them
findings.scenario: Anyone who knows an event's ID can mail a CANCEL and the event disappears when the mail is opened, or fake an attendee's answer.

findings.summary: Without UIDPLUS, removing one message can permanently delete others
findings.scenario: On a server without MOVE and UIDPLUS, archiving one mail also erases mails another client had marked for deletion.

findings.summary: Without UIDPLUS, every autosave adds another copy of the draft
findings.scenario: On servers that don't report the new message's ID, Drafts fills with copies while typing and they stay after sending.

findings.summary: A malformed server reply can crash the app
findings.scenario: A tagged reply with an unfinished [code] reads past the end of the buffer.

findings.summary: After a dropped connection, actions can run twice
findings.scenario: The connection drops after the server stored a Sent copy but before it said so; the retry stores a second copy.

findings.summary: Waiting for new mail (IDLE) can mix with another command on the same connection
findings.scenario: A status check sent while IDLE starts gets a BAD answer and both read each other's replies.

findings.summary: Inline images can be swapped when their IDs share a prefix
findings.scenario: Images image1 and image10: image10 shows image1's data and breaks.

findings.summary: The new-mail watcher leaks a connection on each failed IDLE
findings.scenario: While the server refuses the Inbox, every retry leaves a logged-in connection open until the server locks the account.

findings.summary: A mail could perhaps get around blocked remote images with a meta refresh
findings.scenario: A tracking mail redirects to a data: page whose images might load without the injected content rules (unconfirmed whether WebKit allows it).
